name: Devagiri Restaurant
why_it_matters: Daulatabad village mid-budget Maharashtrian kitchen on the fort approach road — the post-fort lunch default for day-trippers from Aurangabad. Maharashtrian veg thali ₹160, non-veg with mutton ₹280.
insider_tip: Lunch 12-3pm fills with the Ellora-Daulatabad-Aurangabad bus-tour rush; arrive 11.30 or after 3pm. Cards + UPI on bills above ₹300.
signature_address: Daulatabad village, fort approach road, Aurangabad District 431002

name: Ajanta Restaurant Daulatabad
why_it_matters: Pure-veg unlimited-thali option on the Daulatabad fort road — quick service for visitors who skip non-veg before the 200m vertical fort climb. Thali plate in 8 min after ordering. Maharashtrian bhakri-pithla-dal-rice-2-vegetables, with table-side refills.
insider_tip: Thali stops at 3.30pm sharp; dinner kicks in at 7. Pre-climb breakfast 9-11am has only the limited-thali option at ₹100. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Daulatabad fort road, near MTDC parking, Aurangabad District 431002

name: MTDC Daulatabad Dining
why_it_matters: MTDC Daulatabad's in-house dining hall at the fort-gate parking complex — the only government-rate mid-range option in the village. Veg + non-veg menu; thali ₹240, biryani ₹290.
insider_tip: Pre-climb breakfast 9-10.30am is the smartest stop — the thali kitchen opens 11am. Cards + UPI. Closed Mondays (fort closure day).
signature_address: MTDC Daulatabad, near fort gate, Aurangabad District 431002

name: Ananth Pure Veg
why_it_matters: Daulatabad village budget thali stop on the main road — ₹120 unlimited Marathwadi-style thali (drier bhakri + heavier pithla + 2 vegetables + dal + curd-rice). Locals-only, no English menu, but waiters speak basic Hindi.
insider_tip: Marathwadi bhakri uses jowar + bajra (drier than Pune-style wheat bhakri); first-time visitors should ask for the softer ones. Cash only; no UPI signal at the village junction.
signature_address: Daulatabad village main road, near bus stand, Aurangabad District 431002
